title: Symmetries, Lax pair, and nilpotent Darboux transformation for the KdV-ghost system
summary: We analyze the KdV--ghost system arising from the BRST formulation of BF-type topological field theory, its symmetries, Lax pair, spectral problem, zero-curvature formulation and Darboux formalism. The system is invariant under shifts of the ghost field, whose generator does not commute with the BRST symmetry of the KdV--ghost system. Their generators allow the introduction of a systematic procedure for generating new solutions from a given one, and the corresponding expressions in the Grassmann algebra are obtained explicitly.
